about: Tableau's JSON bodies, as the 2.0 models read and write them. Every fixture here is synthetic: written from the REST API reference's XML example for its call, converted by the rules a live server showed (Tableau Server 2025.1, REST API 3.25, 2026-10-31): no tsRequest or tsResponse wrapper; attributes and child elements as members; a list in its wrapper object, as an array even for one item, and an empty list as an empty object; xs:integer values as strings, xs:int values as numbers, xs:boolean values as booleans; an element's text beside its attributes as value. Every value is invented. A fixture recorded from a site replaces its synthetic one and says so here; one only a Tableau Server can give stays synthetic until a maintainer records it by hand.
